##### Project general facts

Rabdan Gates is a contemporary residential development in Majan, designed to offer a stylish and well-balanced urban lifestyle in a vibrant community setting. With its elegant architectural expression and thoughtfully planned living spaces, the project presents a modern residential environment tailored to a wide range of lifestyles. Offering a collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, Rabdan Gates is conceived as a place where comfort, practicality, and contemporary design come together to create a welcoming home for individuals, couples, and families alike.

The lifestyle at Rabdan Gates is enriched by a curated selection of amenities that bring a resort-inspired atmosphere into everyday life. Residents can unwind by the infinity pool, enjoy open-air leisure experiences such as the outdoor cinema and mini golf, or make use of the gym and outdoor fitness areas for an active routine. Family-friendly spaces, including dedicated children’s play areas, add to the sense of community and make the project especially appealing for modern family living, creating an environment where recreation and relaxation are seamlessly integrated.

Inside, the residences reflect a clean and modern design approach, enhanced by high-quality finishes and a semi-furnished setup that adds both comfort and convenience. Equipped kitchens and carefully composed interiors create homes that feel practical, polished, and easy to personalize, while the overall design emphasizes a sense of warmth and livability. Altogether, Rabdan Gates is designed as more than just a residential address — it is a thoughtfully crafted living destination where contemporary comfort meets everyday ease.

##### Location description and benefits

Majan is a 1.5 million square meter district in Dubai. It is located at the heart of the large Dubailand community. Majan is a perfect place for those who are looking for a buy-to-invest property. While the community is developing, apartment prices have not yet reached their maximum values. If you want to purchase an off-plan housing unit, you can count on a good discount.

With Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road at its front, Majan lies in close proximity to Al Ain Road. These roads provide Majan strategic access to Al Ain, Sharjah and Abu Dhabi. The area comprises 100 residential complexes, six iconic towers, four hotels and mixed-use units.

The main advantage of Majan is its proximity to high-ranked schools, business and shopping centers, medical facilities, major amusement parks, and sports facilities. While the community boasts its excellent location and good infrastructure, rental rates are not as high as in the seashore or central parts of the emirate. Affordable prices attract locals and tourists who want to rent an apartment in a good area at an affordable price.
